comment: Passkeys (ADR-0066): the WebAuthn RP-ID is the apex circletools.ch (Auth:Passkey:ServerDomain), so Android Credential Manager fetches THIS file to authorize the app's passkeys. get_login_creds is the relation passkeys require; the Secret-Santa Android app authenticates against this RP. The fingerprint MUST be Play's APP SIGNING key (Play Console > App integrity > App signing key certificate), NOT the upload key — Play re-signs every distributed build with the app-signing key, so that is the cert on-device that Credential Manager validates. First entry: the app-signing key (Play tracks). Second entry: the local/upload key, so a sideloaded dev build also validates. Add more apps' packages here as they ship.
